entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been moved with prayer to direct the learned court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Varanasi to decide the Criminal Case No.4109 of 2016 (State vs. Sheikh Irshad & others) arising out of Case Crime No.01 of 2015, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Mahila Thana, District Varanasi, pending before him within specific period as fixed by this Hon'ble Court.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Criminal Case No.4109 of 2016 (State vs. Sheikh Irshad & others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana, District Varanasi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that a Criminal Case No.4109 of 2016 is pending before the learned court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Varanasi since 2016, in the meantime proceedings were started.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.3, Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Till now the chief-examination of PW-1 has been recorded Shadab Bano vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58638751/
1 and case is fixed for rest evidence, therefore, prays that a direction be issued to the learned court concerned to decide the same as expeditiously as possible.

entities.text: Shadab Bano vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties as well as perusal of record and the order sheet, it appears that cross examination of PW-1 is continuing till now, therefore, it is expedient to direct the learned court concerned to make its endeavour to proceed with the trial as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, in accordance with law, if there is no other legal impediment.
Accordingly, this application is disposed of finally with the above direction.
Order Date :- 13.3.2024
